info.name: RegulaOne
info.description:
RegulaOne platform API — one folder per controller, matching the backend package layout (auth / user / tenant / billing / dashboard / notification). Set collection variables baseUrl and token. Most endpoints require a Cognito JWT: log in via SSO Controller > Login (sets an httpOnly cookie in Postman's cookie jar) or paste a bearer into the {{token}} variable.

Every URL here is verified against the backend's own endpoint contract, RegulaOne/backend/src/test/resources/api-surface.txt, which ApiSurfaceTest asserts on each build. If an endpoint changes there, update this collection in the same commit.

item.name: Auth Controller
item.description: AuthController — registration, the person's own profile, and passwords.

request.description: Starts a password recovery. Always answers the same way whether or not the account exists, so it cannot be used to discover who has an account.
Finishes the recovery with the emailed code. code is 6-64 chars, newPassword 8-256.

item.name: SSO Controller
item.description: SSOController — the cookie-based session: sign in, refresh, sign out.

item.name: Dashboard Controller
item.description: DashboardController — the three read-only overview screens. Each one is audited.

request.description: One snapshot of the company's compliance position across all six modules. The company is taken from the session token — there is deliberately no tenantId parameter. Requires ROLE_ADMIN.
What the signed-in person themselves has to do, across the same six modules. Open to any signed-in user, because it only ever returns the caller's own records.

item.name: Admin User Controller
item.description: AdminUserController (was AdminController) — team management inside ONE company. Requires ROLE_ADMIN.

item.name: Platform User Controller
item.description: PlatformUserController (was SuperAdminController) — user administration across every company. Requires ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN; the only path that may grant platform-level permission codes.

item.name: Tenant User Controller
item.description: TenantUserController (was UserController) — the staff list the other RegulaOne apps read. Any signed-in user.

item.name: Tenant Controller
item.description: TenantController — the customer organisation. Superadmin CRUD, plus the two self-service routes a company admin uses on their own organisation.

item.name: Subscription Controller
item.description: SubscriptionController (was PackageController) — the plan catalogue and customer subscriptions, plus the two company-admin billing routes.

item.name: Notification Controller
item.description: NotificationController — the signed-in person's own notifications. module is mandatory on every data endpoint.

item.name: Internal Messaging Controller
item.description: InternalMessagingController (was NotificationIngestController + EmailController) — service-to-service only. No user session; guarded by the X-Service-Token header.

item.name: Health Controller
item.description: HealthController — liveness, and a dev-profile-only database check.
